subject.title: [Feature] Skip catchup rerun for cron jobs with lastRunStatus=ok within current schedule window

question: Which linked cron catch-up fix path should become canonical for this issue before merge?
rationale: There are two open closing PRs with complementary strengths, so automation should not open a third repair or close the issue before maintainers choose or consolidate the landing path.

options.title: Consolidate proof and boundary coverage
options.body: Land a single candidate that combines real CronService proof with stale-ok skip, newer missed-slot replay, and exact-boundary replay coverage.

options.title: Land the proof-positive PR first
options.body: Proceed with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101998 after maintainer review and track or port the boundary coverage separately.

options.title: Wait for the boundary PR proof
options.body: Keep both candidates open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102004 adds real behavior proof and exact-head CI is clean.

recommendation.title: Consolidate proof and boundary coverage
recommendation.body: Land a single candidate that combines real CronService proof with stale-ok skip, newer missed-slot replay, and exact-boundary replay coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron scheduler work makes Peter a reasonable routing owner for choosing the canonical fix path.
